steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize standard project metadata, set app name to 'Notes Manager', and define the package name 'com.notesmanager.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the root and app level build.gradle files with AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and SDK 34 specifications with strict Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define the AndroidManifest.xml file with package declarations, launcher MainActivity, and the system material light theme.

steps.title: Design App Colors and Styles
steps.description: Create basic color definitions in XML resources for standard Material light palettes to use in headers, chips, and list elements.

steps.title: Create Note Item Layout
steps.description: Design the note_item.xml layout which holds the title, details, category tag, timestamp, and action buttons for editing and deleting.

steps.title: Create Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Design the main interface containing search, category selectors, the main notes ListView, and the overlay UI for editing/adding notes.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Create a robust built-in SQLiteOpenHelper in MainActivity to store, search, update, delete, and filter notes by category.

steps.title: Implement Notes Adapter
steps.description: Develop a standard BaseAdapter to dynamically populate note elements inside MainActivity, handling custom click events.

steps.title: Implement Category Filtering
steps.description: Build dynamic category selector listeners using pre-defined categories like Work, Personal, Ideas, etc., to refine lists instantly.

steps.title: Implement Real-time Search
steps.description: Add TextWatcher to the search bar to live-filter existing notes across both titles and descriptions.

steps.title: Implement Add, Edit & Delete Logic
steps.description: Integrate SQLite dialog callbacks and overlay handlers for inserting new notes, modifying existing entries, or prompting deletion confirmations.

steps.title: Building Notes Manager
steps.description: Trigger final compilation and assembling of the Notes Manager application with target system requirements.
